nearest_prior_work: Bartoszewicz, Filipczak, and Prus-Wiśniowski (2013), Theorem 21.10, supplies the general quickly-convergent achievement-set measure formula from which the full Mersenne set has measure one.
Kovač and Tao (2024), Remarks 12-13, supply the strict-tail and unique-coding context for the fixed-base Mersenne series.

The finite/infinite coordinate-face dichotomy is the elementary cylinder law for a fair Bernoulli product: fixing m coordinates costs 2^(-m), and fixing infinitely many prescribed coordinates has probability zero.
classification.attribution: Attribute the full achievement-set measure formula to the classical subsum-set literature and the Mersenne strict-tail/unique-coding premise to Kovač--Tao. Describe the restricted-support dichotomy as standard Bernoulli cylinder calculus transported through the coding; credit the local work for the exact Lean package and #257 consumer, not for a new general measure theorem.
classification.mathematical_interest: The law identifies Lebesgue measure on the fat Mersenne Cantor set with fair binary cylinder mass on every coordinate face. Its striking sharpness is that the positions of finitely many forbidden digits do not matter, while any infinite forbidden set destroys all positive measure.
classification.reusable_scope: Binary achievement sets with injective coding, measurable disjoint translated digit faces, equal face measures, and a known full-set normalization. With unequal digit probabilities, replace the dyadic factor by the corresponding cylinder product.
classification.why_it_matters: The result closes positive-measure selection as a route to choosing an orientation in a rational two-copy #257 fibre, while preserving the crucial distinction that a null set may still contain exceptional points.

primary_sources.venue: Traditional and Present-Day Topics in Real Analysis (2013), 345-369
primary_sources.exact_anchor: Theorem 21.10, printed page 350 (PDF page 6): for a quickly convergent positive series, the achievement set is Cantor and its Lebesgue measure is lim_n 2^n r_n.

exact_anchors: Remark 12: the fast-series condition gives Cantor topology and unique coding.

primary_sources.does_not_support: It does not state the full-set measure-one formula, restricted-support measure law, or rational-fibre nullity.
